widgets_values: Scan is turned OFF. Select 'include_models' and/or 'Include LoRAs' to run.

Select the elements to include in the scan and run the workflow.

The scan searches for models located in the "ComfyUI\models" folder that are NOT present in the workflows saved in "ComfyUI\user\default\workflows". This can help you identify unused models and delete them manually (this tool does not delete anything).

List of models currently supported by the scan:
-background_removal
-checkpoints
-clip
-clip_vision
-controlnet
-diffusion_models
-latent_upscale_models
-loras
-model_patches
-text_encoders
-unet
-upscale_models
-vae
